name: Shizune Daonault
source:
A student at Fukkou Academy, commonly known as Dee.

She has large, curious eyes reminiscent of a cat and brown skin. Her appearance is the spitting image of Towa's sister, who tragically died in the past.

Towa meets Dee on her first day as a transfer student, and they quickly become close. Dee, who is sincere and genuine, gradually earns Towa's trust. Eventually, they are drawn to each other, and even after becoming lovers, they maintain a refreshing innocence. Because Dee closely resembles her late sister, she becomes the most precious person to Towa.
